Tag-triggered pack + NuGet push; every package (incl. Posty5.Store, Posty5.Account) must be in its pack list.
Core options

Package createdFrom labels used when Posty5Options.CreatedFrom is null (dotnetPackage; dotnet for store orders).

posty5-dotnet/<Posty5.Core version> for X-Posty5-Client, read from the assembly.

Link/QR analytics (VA, C2): LinkAnalyticsQuery, LinkAnalyticsModel and its parts, LinkAnalyticsInterval/LinkAnalyticsBreakdown value types.
Account-wide /statistics (VA): LinkStatisticsQuery, LinkStatisticsPeriod, LinkStatisticsResponse<TData>, range, shared visit totals, UTC daily row.
Builds {basePath}/{id}/analytics and {basePath}/statistics with their queries (yyyy-MM-dd dates, breakdown comma list or 'all', period); used by ShortLinkClient and QRCodeClient.
Internal wire names of the analytics endpoint: path segment, query keys, date format, 'all'.
Options, HTTP, exceptions, common response/pagination models, converters.
Posty5.Account package: AccountClient, AccountRoutes, Models (AccountInfo, credits, operation costs, constants).
AccountClient: GetCurrentAsync, GetCreditsAsync, GetCreditUsageAsync, GetCreditUsageSummaryAsync, GetOperationCostsAsync.
The five account routes (/api/api-key/current, /api/user/current/*, /api/plans/operation-costs).
Short-link client/models.
Short-link fixed values: base path, templateType/createdFrom, pageInfo.title filter key, [Obsolete] texts.
QR client/models.
QRCodeTemplateClient: ListUserTemplatesAsync, ListPublicTemplatesAsync (/api/qr-code-template/*-lookup); routes in QRCodeTemplateRoutes.cs.
QR content types (vcard/event/whatsapp/review/social/appStore/file): Create*/Update*Async through SendContentTypeAsync; qrCodeTarget only; file upload flow UploadQRCodeFileAsync.
Thrown when the 60 s signed upload URL of a file code expired before the PUT finished.

Text post requests (workspace/account) and the Facebook/Threads/X blocks.
Story requests (workspace/account), URL media; StoryKinds in StoryKinds.cs.
CreatePostResult (text/story) and RemovePostResult/PlatformRemovalResult.
Online store client/models (Posty5.Store): products, orders, tags, customers, shipping, suppliers.
StoreClient facade: ListStoresAsync/LookupStoresAsync, six sub-clients and the four shorthands.
Routes StoreClient calls itself (/api/store/lookup).
StoreLookupItem (id + "<slug> - <name>").
Shared base: Query()/Add(...) query building for the store sub-clients.
store.Products - /api/store-products.
store.Orders - /api/store-orders (incl. the NeedsAttention filter).
store.Tags - /api/store-tags.
store.Customers - /api/store-customers.
store.Shipping - /api/store-shipping.
store.Suppliers - /api/store-suppliers (dropshipping: connections, catalogue, import, links, supplier orders, part actions).
Dropshipping vocabularies as string constants (no enums).
Supplier catalogue, connection (no credential property), products, import, links.
Supplier order, queue filters, action result, order parts. The queue list is cursor-paged (Core PaginationParams / PaginationResponse<T>).

[StoreFixtureFact]: a live store fact reported as skipped when its POSTY5_TEST_* fixture is missing.
[ApiKeyFact]: a live read-only fact reported as skipped when POSTY5_API_KEY is not set.
[LinkQrTruthPassFact]: a live short-link/QR fact skipped unless POSTY5_TEST_LINK_QR_TP=true (API carries the link-qr truth pass).
[LinkQrVisitAnalyticsFact]: a live GetAnalyticsAsync fact skipped unless POSTY5_TEST_LINK_QR_VA=true (API serves the analytics endpoints).
